ablation.name: brk_x_dim96
ablation.notes: Round 5 Direction 4: Backbone capacity expansion base_dim 64->96. Math: current backbone 315K params (35%), style_memory 491K (54%). Dim 96 expands backbone to ~710K (+125%), improving velocity field expressiveness. Total params ~1.06M (still lightweight). batch_size reduced 96->64 for 12GB VRAM safety. Expected: all metrics improve (stronger representation), but may need longer training to converge.
